hypothesis: Explicit BTC forced-liquidation labels may recover a selective long opportunity absent from V58: forced short-liquidation buying may continue when post-burst price and public flow persist, while forced long-liquidation selling may produce a distinct exhaustion-reclaim long. These are competing causal mechanisms and neither edge is established.
decision: Accept the outcome-blind development timing preflight as raw book-availability evidence, not as an economic result. Freeze a maximum 5000-millisecond delay from the nominal decision to the first complete 20-level entry book and a maximum 30000-millisecond delay from each entry-anchored horizon target to its first complete exit book before opening any return. Classify breaches as technical exclusions in every partition and both branches. The rule excludes 17 development episodes located in two verified zero-book-hour outages; 12 are members of the primary 5s_p95 arm. Permit implementation of the exact exclusion and development-only market replay under the unchanged revision-8 economic contract. Keep validation and pseudo-holdout outcomes sealed until an immutable development result is published. Do not change V58 or claim a BTC-long edge from timing coverage.
falsifier: Reject this preflight if its manifest or row hashes drift, the 1531 treatment identities no longer reconcile, an independent timestamp-only reconstruction changes any entry or horizon book timestamp, or either zero-row source hour is shown to contain omitted complete books. Reject any replay implementation that admits an entry more than 5000 milliseconds late or an exit snapshot more than 30000 milliseconds late. Treat any later change to these latency limits after development returns are opened as a new hypothesis that cannot reuse the existing validation or pseudo-holdout partitions.

latency_contract.entry_boundary: admit when entry_book_time_ms minus decision_time_ms is less than or equal to 5000; otherwise technical exclusion
latency_contract.exit_boundary: admit when exit_book_time_ms minus (entry_time_ms plus horizon_ms) is less than or equal to 30000; otherwise horizon-specific technical exclusion
latency_contract.selection_basis: outcome-blind timestamp cadence and two manifest-verified zero-row book hours

limitations: The preflight parsed book prices only to validate ordered, uncrossed, complete 20-level structure; it did not report prices or compute returns, fills, costs, funding, or PnL.
Raw timestamp availability does not establish an entry signal, sufficient visible depth, profitability, a viable live exit, or portfolio improvement.
The 17 latency exclusions are all exhaustion-branch episodes because the two source outages overlap those episodes; this asymmetric technical exclusion must remain explicit in branch counts.

The 5000-millisecond entry and 30000-millisecond exit limits were selected after timestamp-only development inspection but before any strategy return was opened; they cannot be retuned using later economics.
Official funding history and causal regime labels remain to be acquired and hash-bound before an economic result is complete.
Historical exchange timestamps do not reproduce local receipt latency, hidden liquidity, queue behavior, or actual IOC fills.
